engine.total_path: body text /of (\d+) results/ when server-rendered; otherwise the organic tile count

verified_against_live_ui.notes: Control verified on result COUNT parity: the profiled same-origin fetch returns 132 for 'heavy duty battery', identical to the live UI ('1-16 of 132 results'). The full-text search page server-renders its organic grid (16-132 tiles observed for category terms), so a 0-tile fetch is a genuine empty, not a client-render miss. Ordering spot-check pending.

limitations: The /search results page is hardened by Akamai: full-page NAVIGATION to /search?q= is Access-Denied after light use, and cumulative same-origin fetches trip a durable rate-limit (>15 min). Capture done via same-origin fetch at >=10s spacing, single session, with explicit Access-Denied detection so a block is never mis-recorded as a zero-result.
Result count is client-rendered on the search page; the server-rendered organic tile count is used as total. Verified equal to the live UI count on the control term.
Batch limited to 15 representative terms (not the full 69-term pack) to respect the bot protection.

L10 / client-redirect (CORRECTION): exact part-number search does a CLIENT-SIDE (Next.js RSC) redirect to the product page. A raw server-side fetch of /search?q=<part#> returns the empty pre-redirect grid and MUST NOT be read as zero-result — the earlier part-number 'zero-result' reading was this artifact. Capture must follow the browser's final URL: landing on /product/<part#> = redirected=true, count as answered (known-item hit). Confirmed live 2026-08-14: searching 1R-1808 redirects to /product/1R-1808.
